name: 3S Gentech
author: Joakim
description: The Gentech guild HUD, fed by the Guild.State / Systems / Info / Progress / Stats / Config / Powers GMCP packages (3Scapes only). Tabs: Status (PU, PU store and CPC against their maxima, medkits, timeslides, capsules, guild level and gexp, echelon and its progress toward the next, res credits, attack/defence bias and the tech/gen efficiency), Systems (one row per implanted system - whether it is on, what type or amount it is set to, and its live countdown - plus the energy field level and the DDB / shield / synthorg loadout), Progress (division, class and rank, time in the guild and in combat, kills and deaths, quest points, power slots, every bonus factor, and the quartermaster figures), Stats (this fight's rounds and enemy, the exp and gexp rates, lifetime rounds and CPC used, best and worst enemy by class) and Config (the autoguild order, panic heal, HMS, DNA and the gen timer). 'gt' prints the Status page into the output window and 'gtsys' the Systems page with the countdowns. Built from one capture taken on ANOTHER player's character, so nobody at hand plays the guild: a field whose meaning the capture does not establish is shown under the server's own name with its raw value in a 'Not yet understood' block, rather than given a friendly label that might be wrong. Those fields - g2n, g2n_pct, reset_pct, dgexp, illuminated, rush, phase_rank, and the 'cs' rate suffix on the Stats tab - are listed in docs/Plan-Improvements.md for a Gentech player to identify.
